text:
oliver: Heads-up: security scan found several user SSH keys on prod jump hosts that are older than our 2yr policy and use RSA-2048. We need humans to rotate to ed25519 and enroll in ZTA within 72h. This is mandatory for anyone with prod access. :rotating_light:

laura: Can infra rotate keys for service accounts or CI runners?

infra-bot: Action created: SEC-452 - service and machine key inventory. Infra will handle machine/service keys where humans cannot rotate. Owners: tag your services in SEC-452. https://phabricator.redwood/SEC-452

oliver: Quick steps for humans: 1) ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "redwood-<username>" 2) upload pubkey to https://redwood.internal/bastion-keys or use `rw-infra bastion upload-key` 3) complete ZTA onboarding at https://redwood.internal/zta/enroll and confirm here.

sam-dev: Does CI that pulls code over the jump host need any IP changes?

oliver: No IP allowlist changes. If CI uses long-lived machine keys, open SEC-452 ticket and infra will coordinate a swap window to avoid breaks.

laura: Oncall exception process?

secops: If you're oncall and can't finish in 72h, request ephemeral access via `/ephemeral-access request --reason oncall` for a 1h session. We log it and expect full enrollment afterwards.

sam-dev: I'll run the infra CLI and rotate keys for my team today, will post SEC-452 ticket with service names if any blockers.

infra-bot: Scheduled re-scan in 72h and set reminder for channel @eng-security in 48h.

oliver: Thanks. Anyone who needs help DM me or ping secops. We'll grant short exceptions case-by-case but the goal is full compliance. :lock:
